item.description:
The Dubai Calligrapher Directory is a reference tool provided for informational purposes only.

No Brokerage

We list public contact information for calligraphers based in the UAE. We do not act as brokers, agents, or intermediaries in any transactions or agreements between you and the artists listed.

Accuracy of Information

While we strive to keep our directory accurate and up-to-date, we cannot guarantee the current validity of external links or the availability of the artists.

item.title: Editorial Policy
item.description:
To maintain the quality and reliability of this directory, we adhere to a strict set of editorial guidelines.

Inclusion Criteria

  1. UAE Base: The artist must have clear evidence of being based in the United Arab Emirates.
  2. Public Contact Path: We only list artists who have a reliable, public way to be contacted (website, official social media, or contact form).
  3. Professional Standing: We prioritize artists with a proven track record, exhibitions, or significant contributions to the field.
  4. No Scraped Content: We do not include entries from SEO directories or lead-generation spam sites.

Curated, Not Exhaustive

This is a curated reference, not an exhaustive list of every person who practices calligraphy. We focus on quality and reliability.

item.title: Majid Alyousef
item.description: Majid Alyousef is a master calligrapher and designer based in Dubai. He is globally recognized for his ability to transform the classical Thuluth script into avant-garde geometric compositions. His work is not merely decorative; it is a study of the mathematical beauty of the Arabic letterform.

item.title: Thuluth Script
item.description:
Thuluth: The King of Scripts

Thuluth (Arabic: ثلث, “one-third”) is perhaps the most famous of all classical Arabic scripts. Known for its elegant, cursive flow and complex sloping lines, it has been the primary script for architectural inscriptions in the Islamic world for centuries.

In the UAE, Thuluth is widely used in monumental calligraphy, such as the inscriptions found in the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque and various landmark government buildings. It is a demanding script that requires absolute mastery of proportion.
